# Prototype Specification: Billing Ops Console

## Template & Design System
- **Template**: none selected — custom class system
- **Design System**: Stripe Dashboard DS — dense, functional, blue-on-white
- **CSS Class System**: .topbar .sidebar .main-with-sidebar .card .grid-3 .grid-4 .table .table-wrap .badge .btn .btn-primary .form-input .form-group
- **Color Tokens**: --bg=#ffffff, --fg=#1a1a1a, --accent=#635bff, --surface=#f6f9fc, --border=#e3e8ee, --muted=#697386

## Overview
- **Product**: internal admin console for B2B SaaS billing
- **Target audience**: internal finance/support staff
- **Core purpose**: review subscriptions, invoices, and failed payments
- **Total pages**: 3 (Dashboard, Subscriptions, Failed Payments)

## Pages & Navigation
| Page ID | Route | Purpose | Layout Pattern | Entry Point |
|---------|-------|---------|----------------|-------------|
| dashboard | `#/dashboard` | billing health overview | stat row + chart | Yes |
| subscriptions | `#/subscriptions` | manage subscriptions | table | No |
| failed-payments | `#/failed-payments` | recover failed billing | table + actions | No |

## Page Specifications

### Dashboard (`#/dashboard`)
**Layout**: stat row + chart
**Template classes**: .section .container .grid-4 .card
**Components**:
  - stat cards: MRR $482,300, churned $12,400, active subs 1,204
  - chart: 6-month MRR trend
**Interactions**:
  - stat card -> navigates to `#/subscriptions`

### Subscriptions (`#/subscriptions`)
**Layout**: table
**Template classes**: .section .container .table .badge
**Components**:
  - table: Customer, Plan, MRR, Status, Renewal Date, 6 rows
**Interactions**:
  - row click -> `#/subscriptions/:id`

### Failed Payments (`#/failed-payments`)
**Layout**: table + actions
**Template classes**: .section .container .table .badge-danger
**Components**:
  - table: Customer, Amount, Attempt #, Last Attempt, 5 rows
**Interactions**:
  - Retry Charge button -> simulated retry

## State & Data Model
records: array — realistic seed rows per page above

## Navigation Flows
Dashboard row click -> detail view
Subscriptions row click -> detail view
Failed Payments row click -> detail view

## Design Notes
- Color scheme: mapped from Stripe Dashboard DS tokens above
- Typography: system sans for body, semibold display
- Density: compact
</spec>
